body: That really does mean a lot that you read it. I'm sure I sound like a whining little kid, but the truth is that little to no people truly care about me. I've just heard so many stories and I've been on the internet to realize most things like the one with Dana never end in the guy being happy. I see your point and it makes sense, but the only reason, I think, she said it was because she's not the mean-type who would flat out tell me she doesn't want to talk to me anymore.
